items.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued September 23 at 6:18PM EDT until September 25 at 11:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Warning, up to 2 to 4 feet of
inundation above ground level expected in low-lying areas near
shorelines and tidal waterways. Up to 1 foot of inundation is
possible for sound-side flooding when winds become more
northerly late Thursday and Friday. For the Beach Hazards
Statements, dangerous rip currents, large breaking waves
expected, and strong longshore currents in the surf zone.

* WHERE...Ocracoke Island.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Warning, until 11 PM EDT Friday.
For the first Beach Hazards Statement, until 8 PM EDT this
evening. For the second Beach Hazards Statement, from Thursday
morning through Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Portions of Highway 12
will be inundated. Low lying property including homes,
businesses, and some critical infrastructure will be inundated. Rip
currents can sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into
deeper water. Dangerous shore break can throw a swimmer or
surfer head first into the bottom causing neck and back
injuries. Strong longshore currents will create dangerous
swimming conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The most likely time for strong rip
currents to occur is a couple hours either side of low tide,
which will occur around 12:25 PM Thursday.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

Swimmers should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf
conditions.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 23 at 3:30PM EDT until September 25 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts 40 to 50 mph.

* WHERE...East Carteret and Mainland Dare Counties, and Hatteras
Island, Northern Outer Banks, and Ocracoke Island.

* WHEN...Until 2 AM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued September 23 at 3:20PM EDT until September 25 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 25 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas
16 to 21 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal and offshore waters from Cape Hatteras to
Ocracoke Inlet.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
